mechanism_narrative: Sustained recovery in WORKPLACES mobility (rising from -69.4 to -64.7 over four weeks) signals resumption of commuting patterns that generate incidental retail visits during work-week transit, driving RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved 4.7 points over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not exceed the mean of the last 28 days, or WORKPLACES reverses by more than 3 points in week t+1.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility volatility (swinging from -7.0 to -27.7 to +5.7 to -3.6) indicates unstable outdoor recreation substitution. When PARKS falls below -5 points, consumers redirect discretionary spending to indoor retail venues, increasing RETAIL_REC.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls below -5 points in current week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase in the two weeks following a PARKS dip below -5, or PARKS remains above -5 for the entire forecast period.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT station mobility and RETAIL_REC are coupled through commuter foot traffic. The modest recovery in TRANSIT (from -76.4 to -73.0) combined with WORKPLACES recovery creates a multiplier effect: restored commuting infrastructure access drives retail footfall upward over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:both series show consistent week-on-week improvement
failure_condition: Either TRANSIT or WORKPLACES reverses by more than 2 points in any single week, or RETAIL_REC fails to exceed baseline mean over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM mobility stabilization (declining from -34.1 to -29.3 and holding) signals relaxation of essential-only shopping restrictions. This regime shift permits consumers to resume discretionary retail visits, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM stabilizes within 2 points for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM plateaued at -29.3 for two weeks
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM declines by more than 3 points in the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC remains below -75 for the entire forecast period.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility decline (from +29.3 to +26.7) indicates reduced home confinement, a leading indicator of outdoor and retail activity resumption. The four-week downtrend in RESIDENTIAL predicts RETAIL_REC recovery over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL declined 2.6 points over four weeks
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL rebounds above +28 points in week t+1, or RETAIL_REC does not improve relative to the last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT and RESIDENTIAL move in opposite directions (TRANSIT recovering, RESIDENTIAL declining), consumers are exiting homes and using public transport. This dual signal predicts a one-week lag before RETAIL_REC responds positively as foot traffic converts to purchases.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT improves by >1 point AND RESIDENTIAL declines by >0.5 points in the same week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved 3.4 points and RESIDENTIAL declined 1.2 points from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: In week t+1, RETAIL_REC does not exceed the prior week's value, or both TRANSIT and RESIDENTIAL reverse their directional trends.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES and PARKS mobility show inverse relationship (WORKPLACES improving while PARKS volatile). When WORKPLACES recovery dominates, consumers prioritize work-commute retail over leisure-park substitution, suppressing RETAIL_REC growth. Mechanism predicts flat or negative RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES improves by >2 points while PARKS remains below -5
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved 4.7 points while PARKS declined 9.3 points from t-3w to t-2w
failure_condition: PARKS rebounds above +5 points in any week, or RETAIL_REC increases by more than 2 points relative to the last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC at -77.1 represents a floor effect under severe restrictions. If TRANSIT remains below -70 for the next two weeks, restrictions persist and RETAIL_REC cannot recover, remaining suppressed below -75 over the four-week forecast.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT remains below -70 points for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT at -73.0 and RETAIL_REC at -77.1 in t-0w
failure_condition: TRANSIT exceeds -70 in week t+1, or RETAIL_REC improves by more than 3 points relative to the last 28-day mean.
